//postgres: Empty runs the in-memory stores. A per-user LLM spend cap is then only as old as the process, so set this before relying on one (SPEC §3.3).
//llm: Any subset of the four providers of SPEC §5.7. With none configured, ODE serves M0-M2 and no chat. Keys belong in the environment, not here.
//claude_cli: A development convenience for working without an API key. Reaches ODE's tools over MCP, so it needs public_url to be set.
//llm_pricing: Per million tokens, for the estimated cost SPEC §3.3 accounts against. Matched exactly, else by longest prefix. Not baked into the binary: published prices change, and a stale figure makes a cost cap quietly wrong. Verify before relying on these.
//tool_bounds: The first two bound one projection; the next two bound a whole response. tool_quick_token_budget is what a ranked candidate list may cost the model, tool_profile_max_profiles how many full profiles one profile_series answer carries. Raise them and every tool call carries the difference for the rest of the turn.
